[EN] Arrogance and complacency-old friends of mine.

To be defeated by poison...shameful.
[ES] La arrogancia y la complacencia, viejas amigas mías.

Ser derrotado por veneno... qué vergüenza.

[EN] Don't fear for me. Make ready! They're coming!"Are you all right?"Defend Elleon.
[ES] No temas por mí. ¡Prepárate! ¡Ya vienen!"Are you all right?"Defend Elleon.
